sequence.action_details: Before: bHoldingObject=false | After: Pressed E/Interact. PhysicsCube_Light1 held at 350 units.

sequence.action_details: Before: No HUD | After: WBP_GameHUD overlay visible with 100% Health, Crosshair, and Hold indicator.

sequence.name: physics_object_throw
sequence.label: Throw Physics Object
sequence.action_details: Before: bHoldingObject=true | After: Pressed R/Throw. PhysicsCube_Light1 released with 2500 impulse vector.

sequence.name: hazard_damage
sequence.label: Damage Hazard Zone Overlap
sequence.action_details: Before: Health=100 | After: Walked on DamageHazardZone. UHealthComponent::TakeDamage(25) -> Health=75%.

sequence.name: pause_menu

sequence.action_details: Before: Unpaused | After: Pressed Escape/Pause. WBP_PauseMenu displayed, game loop paused.

sequence.name: resume_gameplay
sequence.label: Resume Gameplay
sequence.action_details: Before: Paused | After: Clicked ResumeButton. WBP_PauseMenu removed, gameplay unpaused.

sequence.name: game_over
sequence.label: Zero Health & Game Over
sequence.action_details: Before: Health=75 | After: Health=0. UHealthComponent::OnDeath fired; WBP_GameOver displayed.

sequence.name: restart_level
sequence.label: Restart Gameplay Level
sequence.action_details: Before: Game Over | After: Clicked RestartButton. Level L_TelekineticDemo reloaded.
